copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会为项目接入Matrix聊天频道：复制注册适配器、安装依赖、修补导入、构建测试，并引导配置独立机器人账号，使机器人可通过Matrix服务器收发消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加Matrix频道集成、配置Matrix机器人，或提及Matrix相关接入时触发。

say.note: 执行复制、注册、安装依赖等步骤。

say.text: 给机器人配置Matrix账号，用用户名密码。
检查Matrix适配器的构建和测试。

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude can integrate a Matrix channel: copies and registers the adapter, installs a pinned dependency, patches imports, builds and tests, and guides setting up a separate bot account, so the bot can message through any Matrix homeserver.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Matrix channel integration, configure a Matrix bot, or mentions Matrix-related setup.

say_en.text: Please integrate the Matrix channel into the NanoClaw project.
Set up the Matrix bot account using username/password.
Check the Matrix adapter build and tests.
